studies.title: Kīlauea
studies.caption: Glowing lava appears within the dark floor of Kīlauea’s summit crater.
studies.prompt: Safe distant rim view into Kilauea's broad low shield-volcano summit crater during a lava-lake phase, small orange incandescent patches deep within dark cracked basalt, pale rising gas, horizon low. No steep cone, giant fountain or visitors near lava.
